<!-- generated by scripts/cli-reference.mjs from `goback docs`; do not edit -->

Without a subcommand: sweep, retire, compact and build presence filters, garbage collect once the last collection is older than --gc-interval, and rebuild the index's indexes of tables that churned. A subcommand runs one operation

```sh
goback [global flags] maintain [flags] <command>
```

| Flag | Description | Environment | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--gc-interval value` | garbage collect when the last collection is at least this old; 0 never collects |  | `168h0m0s` |

## maintain sweep

Finalize idle archives and end sessions whose lease ran out

```sh
goback [global flags] maintain sweep
```

## maintain compact

Rewrite small archives into full-sized ones

```sh
goback [global flags] maintain compact
```

## maintain retire

Tombstone every retired commit past its window

```sh
goback [global flags] maintain retire
```

## maintain presence

Build the presence filter of every set whose newest commit has none

```sh
goback [global flags] maintain presence
```

## maintain check

Report the commits the store holds that the index has no row for and no tombstone retires

```sh
goback [global flags] maintain check
```

## maintain sizes

Record the logical size of every commit that carries none, and the sizes of every set whose commits changed

```sh
goback [global flags] maintain sizes
```
